baselineDisplay.title: 一栋特别的大房子
baselineDisplay.text:
第十八单元 第一课【故事复现】一栋特别的大房子 （上）
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Why is the new house special?
问题：为什么这个新房子很特殊？
• 词汇准备
• complete 完成
• modern 新式的，与以往不同的
• strange 奇怪的
• district 地区
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
I had a letter from my sister yesterday. She lives in Nigeria.
昨天我收到了姐姐的一封信，她住在尼日利亚。
In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year. If she comes, she will get a surprise.
在信中她说她明年将到英国来。如果她来了，她会感到非常惊奇了。
We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
我们现在住在乡间的一栋漂亮的新住宅里。
Work on it had begun before my sister left. The house was completed five months ago.
这栋房子在我姐姐离开之前就已动工了，是在 5 个月以前竣工的。
In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us. The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden.
我在信中告诉她，她可以和我们住在一起。这栋房子里有许多房间，还有一个漂亮的花园。
It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people. It must be the only modern house in the district.
它是一栋非常现代化的住宅，因此在有些人看来很古怪。它肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅。
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 What will your sister do next year?
2 Will she get a surprise if she comes or not?
3 Have you a new house in the country or not?
4 Have you invited your sister to stay with you or not?
5 Is it a very modern house, or is it an old house?
6 Has it got many large rooms and a lovely garden or not?
Answer: My sister will come to England next year. She will get a surprise if she comes. We have a new house in the country. I have invited my sister to stay with us. It is a very modern house. It has got many large rooms and a lovely garden.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 The writer's sister will be surprised _______.
(a) when she sees the writer's new house
(b) when she comes to England,
(c) when she sees the writer
(d) when she leaves Nigeria
2 Some people will find the house strange because ______.
(a) it is modern
(b) it is new
(c) it is large
(d) it is old
3 If she ______ she will get surprise.
(a) comes
(b) came
(c) has come
(d) will come
4 I like my sister's house. it's a _______.
(a) new beautiful house
(b) beautiful house new
(c) beautiful new house
(d) new house beautiful
5 The house ______ five months ago.
(a) has completed
(b) completed
(c) was completed
(d) has been completed
6 I told her she could stay with us. That's what I ______.
(a) said to her
(b) said her
(c) told to her
(d) told
7 The house has many large rooms. ______ many large rooms
(a) They have
(b) They are
(c) There have
(d) There are
8 I had a letter yesterday. I _____ one.
(a) sent
(b) took
(c) wrote
(d) received
9 She will come to England ______ year.
(a) last
(b) next
(c) the other
(d) the last
10 Our house is in the country. It's not in ______.
(a) Nigeria
(b) the city
(c) England
(d) France
11 Work on it had begun before my sister left. My sister left _____ it had begun.
(a) after
(b) without
(c) behind
(d) soon
12 It is a very modern house. It was built ______.
(a) lastly
(b) late
(c) latest
(d) recently
Key: 1 a 2 a 3 a 4 c 5 c 6 a 7 d 8 d 9 b 10 b 11 a 12 d
第十八单元 第三课 主动语态与被动语态的转换（下）
▶ 短语动词主动句的转换
短语动词分两类，一类由动词+副词小品词组成，另一类由动词+副词小品词+介词小品词组成，其作用相当于及物动词，因此通常可以带宾语。转换时，小品词不能漏缺。
• They put off the sports meet because of the bad weather.
因天公不作美，他们推迟了运动会。
▪ The sports meet was put off because of the bad weather.
因天公不作美，运动会被推迟。
• We should do away with outmoded conventions and customs.
我们应废除陈规陋习。
▪ Outmoded conventions and customs should be done away with.
陈规陋习应当废除。
▶ 介词短语主动句的转换
介词短语由不及物动词+介词构成，其作用相当于及物动词，因此可以带宾语。转换时，介词小品词不可漏缺。
• The committee decided that it should look into the bribery case immediately.
该委员会决定：立即调查这起贿赂案。
▪ The committee decided that the bribery case should be looked into immediately.
该委员会决定：这起贿赂案应立即调查。
• They did not arrive at any agreement at the conference.
他们在会议上未达成任何一致意见。
• → No agreement was arrived at at the conference. 会议未达成任何一致意见。
注：有些介词短语的被动语态仅表示引申意义，像下面的句子就不能转换成被动句。
• Airmail can arrive at the destination very quickly.
航空信可以很快到达目的地。
▶ 成语动词主动句的转换
有些“动词+名词+介词”的成语动词是约定俗成的，其作用相当于及物动词，如：attach importance to，make fun of，make use of, pay attention to，put an end to，take advantage of，take care of 等。
把含有这种成语动词的主动句变成被动句的方法有两种。
▪ 把主动句的宾语变成被动句的主语。
▪ We must make good use of our time.
Our time must be made good use of. 我们必须好好利用我们的时间。
▪ 把成语动词中的名词变成被动句的主语。
▪ We must take good care of children at school.
→Good care must be taken of children at school.
我们一定照顾好学校里的孩子。
▪ We must put an end to waste. 我们必须杜绝浪费。
→An end must be put to waste. 必须杜绝浪费。
▶ 两类被动句型的相互转换
▪ 英语中有一种主动句可以转换成两种被动句型,它们通常是一些表示客观说明的句子。
• People believed that he is honest.
It is believed that he is honest.
He is believed to be honest.
大家相信他是诚实的。
▪ 比较上面两类被动句型可以发现,一类是“it + be+过去分词十 that 从句”,另一类则是“主语+be+过去分词+不定式”(后面这种“主语”为前一类句型中 that 从句中的主语)。通常可用于这两类被动句型的动词有: assume, believe, expect, fear, feel, know, presume, report, say, suppose, think, understand 等比较(同时注意其中时态和动词形式的变化)：
• It is known that she was a good singer.
She is known to have been a good singer.
大家知道她曾是位优秀的歌手。
• It is reported that he was driving fast.
He is reported to have been driving fast.
据报道，他当时车开得很快。
▶ 含有情态动词的主动句转换成被动句
若主动语态中谓语含有情态动词，在相应的被动语态中通常应保留该情态动词，其结构为“情态动词+be(或 be 的适当时态形式)+过去分词”。
• We must take further measures to protect the environment.
我们必须采取进一步措施保护环境。
▪ →Further measures must be taken to protect the environment.
必须采取进一步措施保护环境。
• We cannot do this in short time.
我们不可能在短期内做完这件事。
▪ →This cannot be done in such a short time.
这件事不是短期内可以完成的。
▶ get+过去分词
英语口语中，过去分词之前常用 get 代替 be，有时也可以用 become 代替 be。
• They soon got lost in the thick forest.
他们不久就在茂密森林里迷路了。
• We got excited at the news that our team had won the match.
听到我们队比赛获胜的消息，我们非常激动。
• We became concerned when she hadn’t come home after midnight.
午夜后她还没有回家，我们就担心起来。
• All the passengers and the crew got killed in the air crash.
所有乘客和机组人员在空难中全部丧生。
注：get 常与 arrested, caught, confused, delayed, divorced, dressed, drowned, drunk, elected, engaged, excited, hit, killed, lost, married, stuck 等过去分词连用，
➢ 被动语态与作形容词的过去分词的比较：许多词(如 broken, interested, amused, frozen, locked, shut, tired, upset, worried 等)可以用作形容词，也可在被动语态结构中用作过去分词，但二者有区别。
• I was worried about her health.
我担心她的健康。(形容词：表示状态)
• I was worried by mosquitoes all night.
我被蚊子搅扰了一整夜。(被动语态：表示行为)
注：如果是形容词，后面就不能用“by+行为主体”，也不能变为主动句。

广义的短语动词包括“动词 + 副词小品词”“动词 + 介词”及“动词 + 副词小品词 + 介词”等结构。有些及物，有些不及物，不能一概认为都带宾语。适合转换为被动语态时，原结构中的小品词和介词不能遗漏。
• They put off the sports meet because of the bad weather.
因天公不作美，他们推迟了运动会。
▪ The sports meet was put off because of the bad weather.
因天公不作美，运动会被推迟。
• We should do away with outmoded conventions and customs.
我们应废除陈规陋习。
▪ Outmoded conventions and customs should be done away with.
陈规陋习应当废除。
▶ 介词动词主动句的转换
介词动词由动词和介词共同构成，后面接介词宾语。有些这类结构可以转换为被动句，如 look into a case → the case is looked into；转换时保留介词。能否这样转换取决于具体词义和用法。
• The committee decided that it should look into the bribery case immediately.
该委员会决定：立即调查这起贿赂案。
▪ The committee decided that the bribery case should be looked into immediately.
该委员会决定：这起贿赂案应立即调查。
• They did not arrive at any agreement at the conference.
他们在会议上未达成任何一致意见。
• → No agreement was arrived at at the conference. 会议未达成任何一致意见。
注：同一组合在不同意义下能否使用被动句可能不同。arrive at an agreement 可以用被动结构；arrive at 表示“到达某地”时，通常不作这样的转换。
• Airmail can arrive at the destination very quickly.
航空信可以很快到达目的地。
▶ 成语动词主动句的转换
有些“动词+名词+介词”的成语动词是约定俗成的，其作用相当于及物动词，如：attach importance to，make fun of，make use of, pay attention to，put an end to，take advantage of，take care of 等。
这类习语中，有的可把介词后的宾语用作被动句主语，有的可把习语内的名词用作主语；并非每个习语都同样自然地适用两种方式。
▪ 把主动句的宾语变成被动句的主语。
▪ We must make good use of our time.
Our time must be made good use of. 我们必须好好利用我们的时间。
▪ 把成语动词中的名词变成被动句的主语。
▪ We must take good care of children at school.
→Good care must be taken of children at school.
我们一定照顾好学校里的孩子。
▪ We must put an end to waste. 我们必须杜绝浪费。
→An end must be put to waste. 必须杜绝浪费。
▶ 两类被动句型的相互转换
▪ 英语中有一种主动句可以转换成两种被动句型,它们通常是一些表示客观说明的句子。
• People believe that he is honest.
It is believed that he is honest.
He is believed to be honest.
大家相信他是诚实的。
▪ 比较上面两类被动句型可以发现,一类是“it + be+过去分词 + that 从句”,另一类则是“主语+be+过去分词+不定式”(后面这种“主语”为前一类句型中 that 从句中的主语)。通常可用于这两类被动句型的动词有: assume, believe, expect, fear, feel, know, presume, report, say, suppose, think, understand 等。比较(同时注意其中时态和动词形式的变化)：
• It is known that she was a good singer.
She is known to have been a good singer.
大家知道她曾是位优秀的歌手。
• It is reported that he was driving fast.
He is reported to have been driving fast.
据报道，他当时车开得很快。
▶ 含有情态动词的主动句转换成被动句
若主动句含有情态动词，转换后通常保留该情态动词，并按需要使用 be + 过去分词、be being + 过去分词或 have been + 过去分词等结构。
• We must take further measures to protect the environment.
我们必须采取进一步措施保护环境。
▪ →Further measures must be taken to protect the environment.
必须采取进一步措施保护环境。
• We cannot do this in such a short time.
我们不可能在短期内做完这件事。
▪ →This cannot be done in such a short time.
这件事不是短期内可以完成的。
▶ get+过去分词
口语中可用 get + 过去分词表示某些被动事件；get 或 become 后也可接形容词，表达状态变化。下面的 got lost、got excited、became concerned 着重状态变化，got killed 表示被动事件，不能把所有这些结构一概视为以 get/become 替换 be 的被动语态。
• They soon got lost in the thick forest.
他们不久就在茂密森林里迷路了。
• We got excited at the news that our team had won the match.
听到我们队比赛获胜的消息，我们非常激动。
• We became concerned when she hadn’t come home after midnight.
午夜后她还没有回家，我们就担心起来。
• All the passengers and the crew got killed in the air crash.
所有乘客和机组人员在空难中全部丧生。
注：get 常与 arrested, caught, confused, delayed, divorced, dressed, drowned, drunk, elected, engaged, excited, hit, killed, lost, married, stuck 等过去分词连用。这些形式要结合词义和语境区分被动事件与状态变化。
➢ 被动语态与作形容词的过去分词的比较：许多词(如 broken, interested, amused, frozen, locked, shut, tired, upset, worried 等)可以用作形容词，也可在被动语态结构中用作过去分词，但二者有区别。
• I was worried about her health.
我担心她的健康。(形容词：表示状态)
• I was worried by mosquitoes all night.
我被蚊子搅扰了一整夜。(被动语态：表示行为)
注：区分形容词用法与被动结构，应结合词义、上下文以及是否着重事件或状态综合判断。不能仅凭有没有 by 短语判定；有些分词形容词也可带表示原因等的 by 短语。

blocks.text: 第十八单元 第一课【故事复现】一栋特别的大房子 （上）

• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。

Question: Why is the new house special?
问题：为什么这个新房子很特殊？
• 词汇准备
• complete 完成
• modern 新式的，与以往不同的
• strange 奇怪的
• district 地区

• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

I had a letter from my sister yesterday. She lives in Nigeria.
昨天我收到了姐姐的一封信，她住在尼日利亚。

In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year. If she comes, she will get a surprise.
在信中她说她明年将到英国来。如果她来了，她会感到非常惊奇。

We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
我们现在住在乡间的一栋漂亮的新住宅里。

Work on it had begun before my sister left. The house was completed five months ago.
这栋房子在我姐姐离开之前就已动工了，是在 5 个月以前竣工的。

In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us. The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden.
我在信中告诉她，她可以和我们住在一起。这栋房子里有许多房间，还有一个漂亮的花园。

It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people. It must be the only modern house in the district.
它是一栋非常现代化的住宅，因此在有些人看来很古怪。它肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅。

• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 What will your sister do next year?
2 Will she get a surprise if she comes or not?
3 Have you a new house in the country or not?
4 Have you invited your sister to stay with you or not?
5 Is it a very modern house, or is it an old house?
6 Has it got many large rooms and a lovely garden or not?

Answer: My sister will come to England next year. She will get a surprise if she comes. We have a new house in the country. I have invited my sister to stay with us. It is a very modern house. It has got many large rooms and a lovely garden.

• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。

1 The writer's sister will be surprised _______.
(a) when she sees the writer's new house
(b) when she comes to England
(c) when she sees the writer
(d) when she leaves Nigeria

2 Some people will find the house strange because ______.
(a) it is modern
(b) it is new
(c) it is large
(d) it is old

3 If she ______, she will get a surprise.
(a) comes
(b) came
(c) has come
(d) will come

4 I like my sister's house. It's a _______.
(a) new beautiful house
(b) beautiful house new
(c) beautiful new house
(d) new house beautiful

5 The house ______ five months ago.
(a) has completed
(b) completed
(c) was completed
(d) has been completed

6 I told her she could stay with us. That's what I ______.
(a) said to her
(b) said her
(c) told to her
(d) told

7 The house has many large rooms. ______ many large rooms.
(a) They have
(b) They are
(c) There have
(d) There are

8 I had a letter yesterday. I _____ one.
(a) sent
(b) took
(c) wrote
(d) received

9 She will come to England ______ year.
(a) last
(b) next
(c) the other
(d) the last

10 Our house is in the country. It's not in ______.
(a) Nigeria
(b) the city
(c) England
(d) France

11 Work on it had begun before my sister left. My sister left _____ it had begun.
(a) after
(b) without
(c) behind
(d) soon

12 It is a very modern house. It was built ______.
(a) lastly
(b) late
(c) latest
(d) recently
